dataset.name: IMDb-Face
dataset.source_key: full relative source path under all_faces, typically identity/filename.png; nested directories are preserved
dataset.identity_label: immediate parent directory name, including for nested source paths
dataset.original_image_key: the same full relative path under IMDB_clean_face, with .jpg replacing the crop's .png suffix

quality_partition.quantile_population: all 794629 accepted face crops, before train/test exclusion
quality_partition.predicate_score_precision: original stored score values; float32 conversion applies only to quantile computation
quality_partition.other_rule: all accepted crops outside both LQ and HQ
quality_partition.threshold_comparisons: strict; equal values do not satisfy < or >

iqa_test_split.candidate_rule: LQ images whose identity has no image in the HQ partition
iqa_test_split.remaining_manifest_scope: excludes IQA test images only; still contains identification test identities

identification_test_split.eligible_rule: identities with at least one HQ image and at least one LQ image

selection_algorithm.subset_sum: 0/1 dynamic programming with each identity weighted by its full LQ image count
selection_algorithm.update_order: descending totals from target to identity LQ count; fill previously unreachable totals only
selection_algorithm.termination: stop at first identity after which the target total is reachable
selection_algorithm.output_order: backtrack the first recorded predecessors, then sort selected identity labels

identification_test_split.query_rule: all LQ images of the selected identities
identification_test_split.training_exclusion_unit: all images of every selected identity, including HQ, LQ and other

training_pools.hq_selection_rule: identity-disjoint crops with both quality scores strictly above their global (1 - top_percent / 100) quantiles

without_lq.rule: identity-disjoint all-image pool minus the full LQ partition

stage2_lq.rule: LQ images whose identity occurs in the identity-disjoint Top40 HQ reference pool
stage2_lq.historical_loader_behavior: the original identity-aware dataset applied this same identity intersection when reading the full LQ manifest
stage2_lq.test_exclusion: selected identification identities are absent from references; IQA test identities have no HQ reference

gallery.selection: one random.Random(seed).choice(sorted_HQ_candidates) per identity, traversing identity labels in lexical order with one shared RNG
gallery.reuse: use the published fixed gallery for every model and native-LQ baseline

queries.image_domain: native LQ crops or SR outputs from exactly those crops
queries.sr_matching: match original filenames; require all 2000 queries and reject duplicate matching filenames

source_exclusion.key: full relative source path under all_faces, preserving every directory component
source_exclusion.rule: gallery candidates come only from HQ; queries come only from the disjoint LQ partition; source keys remain unchanged for SR outputs
source_exclusion.content_deduplication: no pixel or perceptual duplicate detection is implied by source-record exclusion

sphereface.color_order: read and resize RGB, then reverse channels to BGR

metrics.similarity: dot product of L2-normalized query and gallery embeddings, equal to cosine similarity
metrics.positive_cosine: mean cosine to each query's same-identity gallery image over all 2000 queries
metrics.rank1: mean(argmax over 476 gallery similarities equals the query identity) over all 2000 queries
metrics.gallery_order_and_ties: lexicographically sorted identity labels; torch.argmax selects the first maximum
metrics.sr_delta: SR metric minus native-LQ metric using the same gallery, queries, checkpoints and preprocessing
